data.notes: July 2027 underground club calendars for New York are not broadly published yet on RA/DICE/Shotgun/Eventbrite, so this list only includes confirmed genre/diaspora events with active source pages.

events.title: Slipknot: (sic)est Stadium Tour
events.summary: Slipknot bring their stadium tour to Citi Field with Bring Me The Horizon and special guest Acid Bath, according to the venue's official concert page.

events.title: Empire Sensual Movement 2027
events.summary: A large salsa, bachata, and kizomba dance congress in Times Square with international instructors, performances, competitions, late-night socials, and early-bird tickets already on sale.

events.title: New York Mambo Experience 2027 + Mamboland ESM Congress
events.venueName: Empire Dance Studio / New York Marriott Marquis
events.summary: A weeklong salsa On2/mambo training and social-dance program: four days at Empire Dance Studio followed by the Mamboland ESM congress at New York Marriott Marquis, with workshops, live music, and socials.
